reviews.author: Cesar Rodriguez
reviews.text: Great team , when every mechanic turn me down because they were too busy . Enroute Auto ,had me covered. Very up front and honest people ,they call to update you on your vehicle and will answer if you call to check in on your vehicle . Treated me like customer and not a burden. Great experience

reviews.author: Jose Garcia
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for a couple of years. I have had my Honda and my wife’s Honda serviced here many times. I can honestly say that I have left this place knowing that I will be in great care going down the road with the work that has been done.

reviews.author: Megan Williams
reviews.text: Best place in town to get a vehicle worked on! Amazing service and fair prices. 10 out of 10. Highly recommend using if Enroute as your go to car repair place!

reviews.author: Just Anobahde
reviews.text: What another shop took 4 days to not even fix, took this shop an hour to fix. Clean, professional, fast. Would recommend this place for the car needs

reviews.author: Lydia Hendrick
reviews.text: My AC broke and they were able to figure out what was wrong with it and repair it in just a few hours. Very friendly and reasonably priced!

reviews.author: Diego Williams
reviews.text: Great place to come get you’re car, truck, bike maybe even a wheelchair. Well trusted ppl that takes care of you and your vehicle
